title: Core: document snapshot export (PNG via OffscreenCanvas)
description: Add snapshotFrame(doc, sceneIndex, frameIndex, width, height): Promise<Blob|null> to packages/core. Uses OffscreenCanvas + CanvasRenderer to render a single frame to PNG Blob without a DOM canvas. If OffscreenCanvas unavailable (Node), return null. Export from packages/core/src/index.ts. Add 4 tests verifying the function signature. See renderer.ts for CanvasRenderer API.
